name: res-status-raw
description: raw res.status(...) responses bypass the Errors.* helpers (server/utils/errors.ts) and drift from the { error, message, details?, statusCode } contract. Use Errors.notFound/badRequest/validationFailed/unauthorized/forbidden/limitExceeded/internal instead.
